citation.authors: Jirapak A, Adams E, Black GM, Devlin BL

cited_by.title: Intermittent fasting for women, older adults, teenagers and people with heart or thyroid conditions

record.population: 6 studies of time-restricted eating in adult females (randomised trials in women with obesity; non-randomised studies in women with PCOS)
record.design: Systematic review of reproductive hormones and androgen markers
record.finding: Randomised trials in women with obesity found no significant change in testosterone, oestrogen, progesterone, LH, cortisol, DHEA or SHBG. Non-randomised PCOS studies reported lower testosterone and LH, possibly because of weight loss. The authors call the evidence inconclusive.
record.note: Searched to May 2024; I did not see ethnicity in the abstract.
